title.narrative: School of Public Action - Western Kazakhstan

description.narrative: The project's objective is to improve quality of life in rural districts of Western Kazakhstan through public service delivery and state resource allocation which effectively meets local needs. In particular, it will be focused on corruption reduction in public procurement in rural communities, on support to civic initiatives in 48 communities in Western Kazakhstan and sharing lessons learned and best practices in citizen-led human development, premised on human-rights based approach.
